name: Do I need an architect or structural engineer for an open floor plan remodel?
description: A structural engineer is essential for load-bearing wall alterations. An architect aids design. Both are key for permitting and safety.

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect or structural engineer for an open floor plan remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if your remodel involves removing or significantly altering load-bearing walls, you will definitely need a structural engineer. An architect can help with design and space planning, ensuring the new layout is functional and aesthetically pleasing. Engaging these professionals early is a crucial preparation step, as their assessments inform permit requirements and ensure structural integrity, especially important in seismic areas like Alameda and Berkeley.
